title: Universal property of the henselization of a pair
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq B$ an ideal, and let $(B^h,J^h)$, $J^h=JB^h$, be the henselization of $(B,J)$ [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization], i.e. $B^h=\varinjlim_{C\in\mathcal C}C$ over the category $\mathcal C$ of etale $B$-algebras $C$ with $B/J\xrightarrow{\sim}C/JC$, and let $\eta:B\to B^h$ be its structure map (the coprojection of the object $\mathrm{id}_B$). Let $(A',I')$ be a henselian pair [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and $\varphi:B\to A'$ a ring map with $\varphi(J)\subseteq I'$. Then there is exactly one ring map $\psi:B^h\to A'$ with $\psi\circ\eta=\varphi$; it satisfies $\psi(J^h)\subseteq I'$. (This is the clause 'left adjoint to the inclusion of henselian pairs into pairs' of Stacks 0A02, dropped from [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization] at its review.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 0A02 (lemma-henselization, line 2980), last paragraph of the proof ('Let $(A,I)\to(A',I')$ be a morphism of pairs with $(A',I')$ henselian. We will show there is a unique factorization $A\to A^h\to A'$ ...'): sections $\sigma_B:A'\otimes_AB\to A'$ by Lemma Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair, (1)$\Rightarrow$(2)), their uniqueness by Algebra Lemma Tag 02FL (lemma-diagonal-unramified) and Lemma Tag 09XF (lemma-idempotents-determined-modulo-radical), then $\colim\sigma_B$; $\psi(J^h)\subseteq I'$ since $J^h=JB^h$
